text: Provides step-by-step managed processes so an agent can handle incorporating, hiring, payroll, and similar company tasks
quote: Step-by-step managed processes to let your agent handle incorporating, hiring, payroll, and more.

text: A process can be started in one agent and finished in another, across laptop and phone
quote: Start a process in one agent and finish it in another, on your laptop or your phone.

text: Company data and work in progress carry over when you switch to a new AI model
quote: Move to a new model the day it ships. Your company and work in progress come with you.

text: Runs no model of its own and uses the AI plan you already pay for
quote: Ultrametric runs no model. The work uses the AI plan you already pay for.

text: Offers a hosted remote MCP server that agent hosts can connect to by URL
quote: In your agent host's remote MCP settings, add a connection with this server URL: https://api.ultrametric.ai/mcp

text: Official CLI installs with a single global npm command
quote: npm install -g ultrametric@0.4.1

text: With --json, an agent can complete flows without interactive prompts
quote: With `--json`, the agent gets the link and controls completion without an interactive prompt.

text: The init command has a dry-run mode that previews changes before any skill files are written
quote: ultrametric init --dry-run --json ... The first command previews changes. The second writes the selected skill files.

text: Init writes only the skill files you selected
quote: ultrametric init --dry-run --json ... The first command previews changes. The second writes the selected skill files.

text: Skill files can be committed to the repo to share the setup with your team
quote: You can commit the skill files to share the setup with your team.

text: Page through a catalog of process guides and retrieve the instructions an agent needs
quote: Page through the catalog and retrieve the instructions your agent needs.

text: Retrieve a specific version of a guide by its integer version number
quote: To select a specific version, replace `VERSION` with its positive integer version number

text: Adapters can add local project context to guide responses, and that context stays local during retrieval
quote: adapters accept `--path` to add local project context and a template to the guide response. That context stays local during retrieval.

text: Persists decisions, documents, and process progress so the next session can pick them up
quote: Keep decisions, documents, and process progress for the next session.

text: A --period option creates a separate run of a recurring process for a specific period
quote: Use `--period` when a recurring process needs a separate run for a particular period.

text: Find a saved company, run, or record from a new agent session
quote: Find a saved company, run, or record in a new agent session.

text: View the change history of a single record or run through the CLI
quote: For history, select one record or run: ultrametric context get --record RECORD_ID --history --json

text: Record updates require the current revision, which prevents one session from overwriting another's changes
quote: An update to an existing record must include its current revision so one session does not overwrite another session's changes.

text: Saves are idempotent, so a timed-out save can be safely retried with the same update key
quote: If a save times out, retry the exact input with the same update key.

text: MCP and CLI connections share the same process service and hosted company records under one account
quote: Both connections use the same process service and hosted company records. Sign in to the same account and organization to continue work across them.

text: An HTTP API is available for reading process guides and working with company context
quote: Read process guides and work with company context over HTTP.

text: A downloadable OpenAPI contract describes the request and response schemas
quote: download the [OpenAPI contract](/contracts/openapi.json) for request and response schemas

text: The CLI's --json mode returns structured stdout with a schemaVersion and data object for agents
quote: Use `--json` when an agent runs the CLI. Successful results appear on stdout as a `schemaVersion` and `data` object.

text: The CLI can target either a staging or a production environment
quote: The `--environment` option accepts `production` or `staging`.

text: A doctor command reports the CLI version, the selected API origin, and local file locations
quote: `doctor` reports the CLI version, selected API origin, and local file locations.

text: Permission scopes include a separate one for reading protected context
quote: Read protected context | Also `context:protected:read`

text: The MCP status tool reports release access and availability for a process
quote: ask the agent to call MCP `status` with its `processId`. The result includes `releaseAccess` and `available`.
